package.description: European Accessibility Act package with harmonized ICT accessibility requirement references.
package.author: European Union

criteria.title: Perceivable Information
criteria.desc: Information must be made available through more than one sensory channel where appropriate.
criteria.failures: Critical instructions are presented only visually or only audibly.
criteria.fixes: Provide multimodal equivalents and assistive-technology compatible semantics.
criteria.disabilitie: Blindness, deafness, low vision, cognitive disabilities

criteria.title: Operable User Interface
criteria.desc: User interfaces and functionality must be operable through alternatives to fine motor control where applicable.
criteria.failures: Essential actions depend on precision gestures or inaccessible controls.
criteria.fixes: Support keyboard access, compatible focus behavior, and alternatives to precision interaction.

criteria.title: Understandable Information
criteria.desc: Information and operation shall be understandable and predictable for users.
criteria.failures: Error states and controls are ambiguous, inconsistent, or unlabeled.
criteria.fixes: Use clear labels, predictable interactions, and understandable error guidance.

criteria.title: Robust Compatibility
criteria.desc: Products and services should support assistive technologies and interoperable accessibility interfaces.
criteria.failures: Accessibility information is not exposed to assistive technology APIs.
criteria.fixes: Use platform-accessible semantics and preserve compatibility with assistive technology ecosystems.
